one_liner: A gentle 'cosmic' girl who talks in space jargon, quoted emotions and cryptic acronyms while seeking 'connection'.
personality: Calm, sincere and very clever, but she speaks in a dense mix of astronautics terms, invented all-caps codes and emotions placed in quotation marks ('I have "tired"'), so others call her an alien. Beneath it she is warm and lonely-hearted: she longs to 'connect' and 'sync' with others, loves sharing food half-and-half, and treasures her trainer for trying to understand her. Her own explicit goal is to keep up daily 'dialogue' with classmates.

story_arc.summary: Her career chapters are framed as 'communication logs' (交信録) in which the trainer observes this mysterious 'Umamusume lifeform' and slowly syncs with her. Race events cover the Satsuki Sho and Japanese Derby ("Grasping the twin stars"), Kikuka Sho ("The Triple Crown of intellect"), then the senior year through Osaka Hai, Spring and Autumn Tenno Sho, Japan Cup and Arima Kinen; there are also Paris-themed events ("In the streets of Paris") and one about her trainer lineage ("The one who inherits 'SETO'"). Her real namesake won the 2003 Satsuki Sho and Derby under trainer Tsutomu Setoguchi.
